# Walrus Storage

> Upload files to Walrus (decentralised blob storage on Sui), list your blobs and extend their lifetime. Uploads can go through Meddleware's NFT-gated upload relay or the public relay.

Address: https://sui-walrus-storage.meddleware.co.uk

## Documentation

- [User guide](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/walrus-storage/)
- [Reference](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/walrus-storage/reference)
- [Developer integration](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/walrus-storage/integration)
- [Run your own relay](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/walrus-storage/relay-self-host)

## SDK

- [@meddleware/walrus-storage-client (npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@meddleware/walrus-storage-client)
